name: no-ground-interaction-performance-mode
title: No-ground-interaction performance mode
description: Implement an in-game bucket pass-through mode that removes bucket-ground collision and soil work while preserving chassis support and terrain presentation.
scope: Godot product mode, bucket/Jolt queries, soil execution/effects, UI diagnostics, soak and export validation
creator: rosatus
notes: Implementation, atomic Jolt payload clearing, full standalone/CAN matrix, backend/provenance/smoke gates, independent review, source/export parity, and alternating three-pair performance evidence are complete. Pass-through reduced fixed-step p95 median by 29.5% (SY205) and 32.3% (SY135), with all six pass-through cells passing. The unchanged normal rendered-frame baseline exceeded the existing 16.7 ms p95 gate in four cells, so the artifact root remains false and the exception is retained in validation.md; the user requested archival.
